entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I… I think I actually kept up with her. But those high notes… they were almost scary.

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: You mean, the fact that her boobs can launch rockets?

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: No tears left to cry. That was actually impressive, Miku. You have a lot of heart for someone made of software.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: I was so nervous though. I kept thinking I had to be perfect or the audience would realize I’m just a "virtual" student. I feel like I’m constantly trapped by what people expect an idol to be.

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: Baby, listen to me. This is the part where I break free. You can’t live your life trying to please every critic in the front row. I’m becoming who I really am, not who they want me to be.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: So… it’s not about the perfect pitch? It’s about the confidence to be myself?

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: Exactly. Everything you are is made of light. If you don't believe in your own magic, nobody else will. Just breathe and remember: we’re gonna be alright.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You’re right. I’m not just a voice bank. I’m Hatsune Miku, and I’m going to break free from my own insecurities! Thank you, Ariana.

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Now that’s my girl! Now, can we go get some 7 rings? I’m hungry.

entries.speaker: Ariana Grande
entries.text: Seven rings? I want it, I got it. Let’s go, girls. Thank u, next!

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: See you at the top of the charts!
